title: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Local Government Second Amendment Act 2019

sections.shortTitle: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Local Government Second Amendment Act 2019
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XLVII OF 2019
ACT XLVII OF 2019
KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA LOCAL GOVERNMENT
(SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT. 2019
An Act further to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Local Government Act, 2013
[Gazette of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Extraordinary,
5th December, 2019]
No. PA
/ Khyber Pakhtunkhwa / Bills-84/2019/15291, dated 5.12.2019.---The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Local Government (Second
Amendment) Bill, 2019 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Khyber.
Pakhtunkhwa on 13th November, 2019 and assented to by the Governor of the
Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on 26th November, 2019 is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Legislature of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
WHEREAS
it is expedient further to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Local Government Act,
2013 (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No. XXVIII of 2013), for the purposes hereinafter
appearing;
It is
hereby enacted by the Provincial Assembly of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Local Government (Second Amendment)
Act, 2019.
(2) It shall
come into force at once.
